answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The desk only stamps a name that carries Puntybound vial maker pane certificate, and the stamp itself rests on a certificate vial makers file after blowing floor checks. Each attempt carries a fare of £83 for the journey to the registry, paid per name, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. The marble is checked, not assumed. The tally keeps lantern. The quartz is on the docket.
